scope: local release-candidate bundle, no-publish boundary, forbidden state exclusion, dependency/secret/untrusted scans

evidence.risk: release-candidate bundle executes or recommends a publish/release/deploy command
evidence.evidence: release-candidate-bundle validation rejects npm publish, gh release, deploy, git push, and promotion apply patterns

evidence.risk: bundle, PKT-17/18 input evidence, or command output grants release, publish, promotion, residual-risk, productization, or User UAT approval
evidence.evidence: AUTHORITY_DENIAL is required and overclaim tests reject true authority flags

evidence.risk: root runtime/generated/local/credential state enters the release-candidate package manifest
evidence.evidence: forbidden-state inclusion test rejects .agents/runtime, generated compatibility artifacts, and generated/local state patterns; remediated live bundle reports 39 forbidden-state exclusions and generated compatibility state is absent from includedPaths

evidence.risk: new dependency, install script, registry, or lockfile drift is introduced by release-candidate tooling
secret, token, or credential appears in scanned release-candidate surfaces
external or untrusted content enters the evidence bundle without labeling

residualRisks.description: Release-candidate evidence remains blocked by unresolved promotion review lanes and cannot be treated as release-ready.
Real provider worker smoke and structured PM source intake remain productization blockers.

requiredFollowUp: Tester must independently verify generated bundle behavior and evidence manifest.
Reviewer must adjudicate all four closeout lenses before Planner closeout.
Planner closeout must preserve release/publish/promotion/residual-risk/productization/User UAT non-approval.
